collection.description: A child believes the moon follows them wherever they walk.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A child believes the moon follows them wherever they walk.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: They imagine that the moon responds to their attention.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: An adult demonstrates how distant objects seem to follow travelers.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: An elder tells a comforting story about the moon watching over families.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: A teacher invites the child to test the idea from several viewpoints.
